Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Fix a forced/synced animation from a paired partner not applying its Penumbra mod option before playing, so it played whatever was already selected instead of the intended one. Fix anchored offsets (spot or furniture) landing wrong — sometimes badly mirrored — the further your current facing was from when the preset was saved, on any anchored preset, not just paired ones; the correction no longer assumes a rotation offset is being applied when the rotation hook hasn't resolved. Fix a synced preset saved by a paired partner anchoring to the sender's own spot/seat instead of the receiver's — each side now anchors to its own current spot or its own seat on the same furniture.
